title: Existing-tab GI product enrichment — initial state-wise batch
description: Expanded state-wise import from the IP India Part A registered-GI register. This batch adds directly transcribed registered entries and shared registrations across multiple regions, including the full listed Uttarakhand block. It remains a representative import, not a claim that every registered GI in the national register has been imported.
